_comment: Open Mirroring targets push source tables into a Fabric Open Mirroring landing zone. Place as config.open_mirror.json (gitignored). Each target binds to an existing source connection id from config.connection.json via 'connection' (default: 'default'). 'landing_zone_root' is the mirrored database's OneLake landing zone or a local staging directory. See https://learn.microsoft.com/fabric/mirroring/open-mirroring-landing-zone-format and devplan/Open_Mirroring_Integration_Plan.md.

tables.name: sales
tables._comment_watermark: Set 'watermark_column' to a non-null monotonic id, timestamp, or rowversion for source-incremental upserts. Omit it for a full-source snapshot scan that also detects deletes.
